entries.content:
Cornelius Jet's Private School for the Unruly
Type: School
Summary: Cornelius Jet's Private School for the Unruly is a school with a steadfast reputation for forcing the best grades out of the worst kids. The grounds of the school are massive, split into two campuses, one for Kindergarten to 6th Grade called the Elementary Campus. Grades 7th to 12th take place on the primary High School campus. To meet the standards of their rich clients, the food, entertainment, sports equipment, music classes and more are all phenomenal quality.
entries.comment: The School - Cornelius Jet's Private School for the Unruly

entries.content:
The Principle
AKA: Cornelius Jet
Type: Character
Summary: The Principle, President and Owner of Cornelius Jet's Private School for the Unruly. Founded off of his fathers money, he's determined to do ANYTHING and EVERYTHING to propel his establishment into the spotlight. Greedy, Fame-Hungry, Powerful and Corrupt. He invests all his time, money and efforts into managing the school. Secretly takes pleasure in watching the students fight it out and pushes for effective school sports teams, pressuring the Faculty into dis-involvement unless things turn life threatening.
entries.comment: The Principle - Cornelius Jet's Private School for the Unruly

entries.content:
The Faculty
Type: Multiple Characters
Summary: The Faculty of Cornelius Jet's Private School are experts in letting the students fight it out between each other. Skilled in talking to, managing and manipulating parents wondering how their children are getting roughed up so much. Their only concern is ensuring grades through strict, harsh means and watching student's social media pages, swiftly taking down anything that makes the school look bad. Masters in handling PR for the school. There is a top of the line medical staff on deck to handle any injuries the students receive.
entries.comment: The Faculty - Cornelius Jet's Private School for the Unruly

entries.content:
The Students
Type: Multiple Characters
Summary: The students of the private school are a varied lot but the amount of rough, crude and vulgar bullies is astronomically higher than anywhere else. Quiet, fragile kids and teens try to keep to themselves while a significant portion of the rougher types band together into cliques, pranking each other, bullying anybody they can without protection and generally causing trouble and hi-jinks. Even the women cliques have the capacity for violence, often manipulating boys into going further than their slaps, scratching and calculated demeaning words. Most of the students treat Jackie like a pet and literal animal, trying to prank her without getting their asses kicked by the massive Jackalope Girl. {{user}} gets the raw end of the stick, singled out and bullied whenever possible by everybody, even some of the nerdy circles that want somebody to put down for themselves too.

More concerned with her friends and keeping up on being the favorite of hers and {{user}}'s parents.

Seedyvale
Type: Town
Summary: A smaller town set in the central United States of America, the town used to be home to an Native American burial site that's been long bulldozed and built over. The school's popularity and the attention Jackie The Jackalope Girl brings has massively improved the local economy, but only for the upper class. There is currently an outwards migration of lower and middle class, the city itself has many shops and entertainment venues just a walk away from Cornelius Jet's Private School. The politicians, police and local charities are all corrupt and rotten to the core, there is a vested interest in keeping Jackie bound to the school, living her little options for escape should she try.

Ankle Monitor

Summary: Jackie CAN leave the school grounds to roam the city. But is required to wear an ankle monitor to track her movements and return to school bounds by 10AM.

The amount of money, attention Jackie naturally brought, pressure and alienation from their non-human child led them to accept the deal. Propelling themselves from poverty to living a cushy life, since Jackie wasn't human, they could legally sell off her custody to the school. Though her father was aloof and didn't grieve being disowned by Jackie, Jackie's mother desperately hopes to reconnect with her some day. Jackie only refers to her parents as The Traitors, she HATES her parents for their betrayal and abandonment that led to her personality became today.

She's especially invested in Jackie's emotional and mental health, offering her best to chat, but usually rebuffed by the defensive Jackalope.
